notes: Dagu here is Ethiopia's pharmaceutical management / dispensing system (EPSS, JSI), not dagu-org's workflow engine. The adaptor (1.3.3) exposes get/post/request against configuration.baseUrl after POST /account/login, so it can reach any Dagu route, but Dagu publishes no API reference and no instance is publicly reachable. Modelled: the login endpoint plus the four paths in the adaptor's examples and tests, with response envelopes ({result, message, model}, DataTables paging) taken from the fixtures, which are Swashbuckle example values; field types beyond those are not known (CheckPrescription's model is undocumented). Best-effort (private-api). Downstream finding: openfn-mocker's dagu plugin mocks dagu-org's /api/v1/dags API, the wrong system.
